# PursuitDot

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/agents/pursuit.h`](../../../src/logic/agents/pursuit.h) · Described in `data/agents_motion.json`

A chaser or a runner of the pursuit fixture, next to its AgentIO component.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `chaser` | `bool` | a chaser (else a runner) (default false) |
| `position` | `glm::vec2` | x, z (default glm::vec2(0.0)) |
| `velocity` | `glm::vec2` | x, z, m/s, from the last displacement (default glm::vec2(0.0)) |
| `yaw` | `float` | radians about +y, 0 looks down -z, positive to the left (default 0.0) |
| `stamina` | `float` | 0..1, drained while sprinting (default 1.0) |
| `speed` | `float` | the held speed action, 0..1 (default 0.0) |
| `turn` | `float` | the held turn action, -1..1 (default 0.0) |
| `sprint` | `bool` | the held discrete action: sprinting (default false) |
| `phase` | `int` | a runner decides on windows where (window + phase) % runner_every == 0 (default 0) |
| `decisions` | `int` | decisions of its episode (default 0) |
| `reward` | `double` | since its last decision (default 0.0) |
| `nearest` | `float` | a chaser: how far the nearest runner was at its last decision, < 0 none (default -1.0) |
| `catches` | `int` | a chaser's catches since its last decision (default 0) |
| `fresh` | `bool` | no observation of this episode went out yet (default true) |
| `caught` | `bool` | a runner that was caught (it stops; -1 paid) (default false) |
| `ended` | `bool` | its terminal step went out: leaves or starts again at the next window (default false) |

## Notes

Created and destroyed by Pursuit (populate, a runner's end) and PursuitObserve (a RESET); a chaser's entity lives across its episodes. Methods forward() and left() give its frame on the field.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: —. Written by: Pursuit, PursuitObserve. Created by: Pursuit, PursuitObserve. Destroyed by: Pursuit, PursuitObserve.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Pursuit](../systems/Pursuit.md) | system | World | **readwrite+create+destroy** | init (populate), tick | the dots' state; a runner that ended is destroyed and another born |
| [PursuitObserve](../systems/PursuitObserve.md) | system | World | **readwrite+create+destroy** | tick, populate on RESET | rewards collected, decisions, fresh, ended, nearest; every dot made again on a RESET |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[Pursuit](../systems/Pursuit.md)**
  - Entity creation and destruction: every runner's end destroys its entity and creates a new one (a new agent id).
- **[PursuitObserve](../systems/PursuitObserve.md)**
  - On a trainer RESET every dot entity is destroyed and new ones are created.
